{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out the sentinel values (-1) in customer_age
valid_age_data = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid data
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age (excluding -1 sentinel values): {mean_age}')"}
